## Checklist

- [ ] Facts are tagged measured, static or untested, with patch and CET version
- [ ] A new reference file has a row in `skills/cp2077-vibe-modding/SKILL.md`'s routing table
- [ ] Generic engine behaviour only, no one mod's tuned values or design
- [ ] No game files, extracted assets, executable strings, story spoilers, machine names, user names or local paths
- [ ] `refs.toml` and `refs.lock.json` change together, if a pin changed
